stations.title: Ines
stations.say: What do I take to the market?
stations.note: Round prices, a cheap table, tags.

stations.title: Market stall
stations.text: Round prices, a cheap table, printed tags.

captions: Saturday is market day, and Ines needs new lists made from the shelf.
Each list means going down the shelf by hand and writing a new one.
You hand small functions to map, filter and find, in four tasks.
Now the round prices, the cheap table and the tags come from the shelf.
The shelf stays the same, and every market list is made from it.
